package controller

import (
	"context"
	"math"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	appsv1 "k8s.io/api/apps/v1"
	metav1 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1"
	"k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1/unstructured"
	"k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/runtime"
	"k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/runtime/schema"
	ctrl "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime"
	"sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/client"
	"sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/client/fake"
)

func setupExpressionTest(t *testing.T, spec map[string]any) (*Reconciler, *unstructured.Unstructured) {
	t.Helper()
	scheme := runtime.NewScheme()
	if err := appsv1.AddToScheme(scheme); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	scheme.AddKnownTypeWithName(schema.GroupVersionKind{Group: "apps.kubiad.dev", Version: "v1alpha1", Kind: "ExpressionApplication"}, &unstructured.Unstructured{})
	application := object()
	application.SetName("example")
	application.SetNamespace("default")
	application.SetUID("expression-test")
	application.Object["spec"] = spec
	application.Object["status"] = map[string]any{"external": "preserved"}
	kubeClient := fake.NewClientBuilder().WithScheme(scheme).WithStatusSubresource(application).WithObjects(application).Build()
	return &Reconciler{Client: kubeClient, Scheme: scheme}, application
}

func expressionStatus(t *testing.T, reconciler *Reconciler, application *unstructured.Unstructured) map[string]any {
	t.Helper()
	actual := object()
	if err := reconciler.Get(context.Background(), client.ObjectKeyFromObject(application), actual); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	status, _, err := unstructured.NestedMap(actual.Object, "status")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return status
}

func TestConditionUsesSpecInsteadOfDeploymentReadiness(t *testing.T) {
	for _, enabled := range []bool{true, false} {
		for _, ready := range []bool{true, false} {
			t.Run(map[bool]string{true: "enabled", false: "disabled"}[enabled]+"/"+map[bool]string{true: "ready", false: "progressing"}[ready], func(t *testing.T) {
				reconciler, application := setupExpressionTest(t, map[string]any{"enabled": enabled, "requiredFlag": false})
				deployment := &appsv1.Deployment{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Generation: 4}}
				if ready {
					deployment.Status = appsv1.DeploymentStatus{ObservedGeneration: 4, UpdatedReplicas: 1, Replicas: 1, AvailableReplicas: 1, ReadyReplicas: 1}
				}
				if err := reconciler.updateStatus(context.Background(), application, deployment, 1); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				status := expressionStatus(t, reconciler, application)
				wantPhase := map[bool]string{true: "Enabled", false: "Disabled"}[enabled]
				if status["phase"] != wantPhase || status["enabledEcho"] != enabled || status["ready"] != ready {
					t.Fatalf("status = %#v, want phase %s, enabled %t and ready %t", status, wantPhase, enabled, ready)
				}
				if status["literalBool"] != enabled || status["external"] != "preserved" {
					t.Fatalf("literal or existing status lost: %#v", status)
				}
				wantLiteral, wantInt := "disabled", int64(0)
				if enabled {
					wantLiteral, wantInt = "line\n\"quoted\"\\n\tend", 42
				}
				if status["literalString"] != wantLiteral || status["literalInt"] != wantInt {
					t.Fatalf("literal values = %#v, want string %q and int %d", status, wantLiteral, wantInt)
				}
			})
		}
	}
}

func TestStatusAssignmentPreservesRuntimeStringsAndIntegerBounds(t *testing.T) {
	for _, count := range []int64{math.MinInt32, math.MaxInt32} {
		message := "line\n\"quoted\"\\n\tend"
		reconciler, application := setupExpressionTest(t, map[string]any{"enabled": true, "requiredFlag": true, "message": message, "count": count})
		if err := reconciler.updateStatus(context.Background(), application, &appsv1.Deployment{}, 1); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		status := expressionStatus(t, reconciler, application)
		if status["messageEcho"] != message || status["countEcho"] != count || status["requiredEcho"] != true {
			t.Fatalf("status = %#v, want message %q and count %d", status, message, count)
		}
	}
}

func TestReconcileDefaultsAndExplicitZeroValues(t *testing.T) {
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name     string
		spec     map[string]any
		image    string
		replicas int32
		phase    string
		message  string
		count    int64
	}{
		{name: "defaults", spec: map[string]any{"requiredFlag": false}, image: "nginx:1.27", replicas: 1, phase: "Enabled", message: "default\nmessage\\n", count: 7},
		{name: "explicit zero values", spec: map[string]any{"image": "custom:1", "replicas": int64(0), "enabled": false, "requiredFlag": false, "message": "", "count": int64(0)}, image: "custom:1", replicas: 0, phase: "Disabled", message: "", count: 0},
	} {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			reconciler, application := setupExpressionTest(t, test.spec)
			request := ctrl.Request{NamespacedName: client.ObjectKeyFromObject(application)}
			if _, err := reconciler.Reconcile(context.Background(), request); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			deployment := &appsv1.Deployment{}
			if err := reconciler.Get(context.Background(), client.ObjectKey{Namespace: "default", Name: "example-application"}, deployment); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if *deployment.Spec.Replicas != test.replicas || deployment.Spec.Template.Spec.Containers[0].Image != test.image {
				t.Fatalf("deployment spec = %#v", deployment.Spec)
			}
			status := expressionStatus(t, reconciler, application)
			for field, want := range map[string]any{"phase": test.phase, "messageEcho": test.message, "countEcho": test.count, "requiredEcho": false, "optionalFlagEcho": false, "optionalMessageEcho": "", "optionalCountEcho": int64(0)} {
				if !reflect.DeepEqual(status[field], want) {
					t.Errorf("status.%s = %#v, want %#v", field, status[field], want)
				}
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestExpressionErrorsDoNotWritePartialStatus(t *testing.T) {
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name, field string
		value       any
		missing     bool
	}{
		{name: "missing required bool", field: "requiredFlag", missing: true},
		{name: "invalid condition", field: "enabled", value: "yes"},
		{name: "invalid required bool", field: "requiredFlag", value: int64(1)},
		{name: "invalid string", field: "message", value: true},
		{name: "invalid int", field: "count", value: "many"},
		{name: "int overflow", field: "count", value: int64(math.MaxInt32) + 1},
		{name: "int underflow", field: "count", value: int64(math.MinInt32) - 1},
		{name: "invalid optional bool", field: "optionalFlag", value: "false"},
	} {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			spec := map[string]any{"enabled": true, "requiredFlag": false}
			if test.missing {
				delete(spec, test.field)
			} else {
				spec[test.field] = test.value
			}
			reconciler, application := setupExpressionTest(t, spec)
			before := expressionStatus(t, reconciler, application)
			if err := reconciler.updateStatus(context.Background(), application, &appsv1.Deployment{}, 1); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("invalid input was accepted")
			} else if !strings.Contains(err.Error(), test.field) {
				t.Fatalf("error = %v, want field %s", err, test.field)
			}
			if after := expressionStatus(t, reconciler, application); !reflect.DeepEqual(before, after) {
				t.Fatalf("status changed on failure: before %#v, after %#v", before, after)
			}
		})
	}
}
